memories.caption: Even standing still beside you, my heart was running towards you
I wasn't looking at the garden, Harini. I was looking at my whole future
Every step I take from now on, I want to take with you
Under your favourite flowers, holding my favourite hand
Yesterday, today and every day after, I am always yours
Standing there, all I was waiting for was you
You smiled at me, and the whole world went quiet
This hug was me saying: you're home now
You make me laugh like nobody else ever could
Even your tears were beautiful that day. I promise to give you only happy ones
My favourite sound in the world is your laugh
Everyone showered us with blessings, but my biggest blessing was sitting right next to me
Wherever you are, that's where I belong
Lying here with you, I knew I had everything I'd ever wanted
No matter what life brings, I've got your back, always
With you beside me, my heart soars higher than these waves
Out of every wave in Vizag, you're the one that swept me off my feet
Running wild by the sea with my favourite person in the world
Holding your hands and looking up. The sky was never this beautiful before you
Lead me anywhere, Harini. I'll never let go of your hand
Every kiss on your forehead is a promise: I will always keep you safe
The moment I placed jeelakarra bellam on your head, I knew we were one forever
That smile, that touch. This is the face I want to wake up to for the rest of my life
Surrounded by garlands, family and blessings, and still your smile shone brighter than everything
Walking towards me with that smile. My heart still skips a beat remembering it
